From 1c1bf34951e8d17941bf708d1901c47e81b15d55 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jack Morgenstein <jackm@dev.mellanox.co.il>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2015 16:53:47 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] net/mlx4_core: Fix wrong index in propagating port change
 event to VFs

The port-change event processing in procedure mlx4_eq_int() uses "slave"
as the vf_oper array index. Since the value of "slave" is the PF function
index, the result is that the PF link state is used for deciding to
propagate the event for all the VFs. The VF link state should be used,
so the VF function index should be used here.

Fixes: 948e306d7d64 ('net/mlx4: Add VF link state support')
Signed-off-by: Jack Morgenstein <jackm@dev.mellanox.co.il>
Signed-off-by: Matan Barak <matanb@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Or Gerlitz <ogerlitz@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c
index aae13adfb492..8e81e53c370e 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c
@@ -601,7 +601,7 @@ static int mlx4_eq_int(struct mlx4_dev *dev, struct mlx4_eq *eq)
 							continue;
 						mlx4_dbg(dev, "%s: Sending MLX4_PORT_CHANGE_SUBTYPE_DOWN to slave: %d, port:%d\n",
 							 __func__, i, port);
-						s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[slave].vport[port].state;
+						s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[i].vport[port].state;
 						if (IFLA_VF_LINK_STATE_AUTO == s_info->link_state) {
 							eqe->event.port_change.port =
 								cpu_to_be32(
@@ -640,7 +640,7 @@ static int mlx4_eq_int(struct mlx4_dev *dev, struct mlx4_eq *eq)
 							continue;
 						if (i == mlx4_master_func_num(dev))
 							continue;
-						s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[slave].vport[port].state;
+						s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[i].vport[port].state;
 						if (IFLA_VF_LINK_STATE_AUTO == s_info->link_state) {
 							eqe->event.port_change.port =
 								cpu_to_be32(
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c`**
   - **Line 601**: The index used to access the `vf_oper` array was changed from `slave` to `i`. This modification ensures that the correct virtual function (VF) link state is used when propagating the port change event.
   - **Line 640**: Similarly, the index was again changed from `slave` to `i` for the same reason as above, ensuring that the VF link state is correctly referenced.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `eq.c` file are directly related to fixing a bug where the port-change event processing incorrectly used the physical function (PF) index (`slave`) instead of the virtual function (VF) index (`i`). By changing the index from `slave` to `i`, the patch ensures that the correct VF link state is used for propagating port change events, thereby addressing the issue identified in the bug report. This change is crucial for the correct functioning of the VF link state support introduced in a previous commit.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[slave].vport[port].state;
```
```c
if (!ret && slave != dev->caps.function) {
```
```c
mlx4_slave_event(dev, slave, eqe);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the code uses the physical function (PF) index (`slave`) instead of the virtual function (VF) index (`i`) when accessing the `vf_oper` array. This results in the PF link state being used for all virtual functions, leading to incorrect propagation of port change events.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[i].vport[port].state;
```
```c
if (!ret && slave != dev->caps.function) {
```
```c
mlx4_slave_event(dev, i, eqe);
```
Reason:
The fix changes the index from `slave` to `i`, which correctly references the virtual function's state in the `vf_oper` array. This ensures that the appropriate VF link state is used for propagating port change events, thus resolving the issue of incorrect event handling for virtual functions.
